'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 T.J. Holman LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[T.J. Holman]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
